about: The fourth review of 1.24.17's rules (2026-11-13), by an agent that had seen neither the rules written nor the three reviews before it: 320 cases of its own on CONVERT's unit names (225, and 60,516 pairs compared with 1.24.16), the history's short versions (52, some through C.turn with a stand-in model) and the runaway chord line (43). Each case has what it expected, what it got on the build it tried and on 1.24.16; 'now' is how it comes out after its findings were mended (tests/bench_1257.js replays the unit names). It found one-word square and cubic names ('sqmeters', 'cubicmetres') lost, Lantern's THE SONG SO FAR kept in a person's old question, a person's 'Make music: that is my goal' named as a block, a note after a block's END left, a cut splitting a block's line, and the chords of a runaway chorus cut while Lantern said 96 bars for a song of 112, or under a tune written on a 'Voice:' line. Mended: see CHANGELOG 1.24.17.
